meaning: Which combination of datasets this row was computed over. One of: ALL3_NKI.NEO.TNBCCL, NKI.NEO, NKI.TNBCCL, NEO.TNBCCL.
The CIM the meta-test was directed TOWARD for this row (Fun or Dys). Every gene appears twice per scope+rho, once per CIM; the p-values differ because the one-sided p is taken toward this CIM.
Per scope+rho verdict for the gene across BOTH cim rows, using the primary (Fisher) test: Fun_only / Dys_only / Both / none.
The |r_rb| cutoff a dataset had to clear to contribute to this gene. One of 0.3.
Gene symbol.
How many datasets are in this scope (3 for the all-three scope, 2 for pairs).

Number of datasets in the scope where |r_rb| >= rho_threshold. MAGNITUDE ONLY -- this does NOT require significance within the dataset and does NOT require the datasets to agree on direction. Identical between the Fun and Dys rows of the same gene.
YES when k_datasets == n_scope_datasets, i.e. the gene cleared the rho cutoff in EVERY dataset of the scope. This is the 'require all three' filter.
Of the k_datasets contributors, how many actually point toward `cim`. This is the DIRECTION-agreement count, as distinct from k_datasets.
YES when k_concordant == k_datasets, i.e. every contributing dataset agrees on direction. Combine with all_datasets_contributed for 'same direction in all three'.
One column per dataset (nki_smc, neo, tnbc_cl). YES if that dataset contributed (|r_rb| >= rho_threshold).
One column per dataset. Which CIM that dataset's r_rb points to (Fun or Dys), or NA where the dataset did not contribute.
Fisher combined statistic: -2 * sum(log(p_one_sided)) over contributors.
PRIMARY meta p-value. Chi-square tail of fisher_stat on 2*k_datasets df. Raw, unadjusted.
fisher_p, BH-adjusted ACROSS GENES within this scope+cim+rho. This is the single point of multiplicity control.
YES when fisher_padj < 0.05.

SECONDARY meta statistic. sqrt(n)-weighted sum of one-sided z toward `cim`, normalised by sqrt(sum of squared weights). Signed: positive favours `cim`, negative favours the other CIM. Cell-line weights use an effective n of 9 (cell lines, not samples).
One-sided normal tail of stouffer_Z. Raw.
stouffer_p, BH-adjusted across genes within this scope+cim+rho.
YES when stouffer_padj < 0.05.
Mean |r_rb| over the contributing datasets, rounded to 3 dp. Used as the effect-size axis in the volcano and as a ranking tie-break.
